After that point: 6 web searches (LBX, Peoria, Dubuque/Davenport, truck-body makers, ND Bobcat suppliers, Milwaukee shovel fabricators) and 5 ECHO NAICS-332312 state pulls added 0 confirmed in-definition plants; the last 4 web searches were status checks (Cat Tazewell, Paladin Customworks, JRB, Continental Salyersville). Not counted: ~45 per-plant EPA FRS lookups used only to evidence plants already found. The earlier stopped run recorded 0 searches; its true count is unknown.
notes: Independent list; ledger plant/evidence/inbox files not opened. Rules applied: (1) rebuild/service rule: a site is IN if its source says it manufactures or fabricates new structures (e.g. Weir ESCO Elko bucket fabrication, L&H Industrial new components, Komatsu Duffield manufacturing); OUT if the source shows only repair/rebuild or a dealer service center (Komatsu Virginia MN, Komatsu Equipment Elko, Joy Lebanon KY). (2) Rows quoting an EPA FRS record (url = frs_rest_services query) prove the facility exists at that address; their products come from the registry NAICS or press and are marked 'not confirmed'. Quote is the FacilityName/LocationAddress pair as returned in the JSON. (3) Astec Materials Solutions sites from the FY2025 10-K are IN because that segment is crushing/screening/conveying equipment, but site-level products for Portland, Stafford, Belleville, Princeton, Duncan, Raleigh are unconfirmed (several are TerraSource sites acquired July 2025). Astec Infrastructure concrete/asphalt-plant sites are marked OUT as borderline. (4) Closed/changed: CNH Burlington (production ended by Q2 2026), Kobelco Moore SC (sold to Takeuchi 2022), Terex Oklahoma City (slated for closure), Bobcat Johnson Creek (mowers). Takeuchi Moore marked OUT as likely assembly-only. (5) Stale sources flagged in products: Monarch (2009), Morton Metalcraft (2004), Weldall, Metso Columbia (2006 opening), LBX (fabrication not confirmed). (6) Failed sources: equipmentworld.com, compactequip.com, vaia/tallo/teal job aggregators (blocked or expired) - not used; FRS rate limit 6 requests/minute. Confidence field: high/medium/low per row. (7) Assembly rule: an OEM site is IN only when a source shows welding/fabrication on site (posting, article, plant tour) or the source says it manufactures the machine structures; sites with assembly/machining evidence only are OUT (Cat Clayton, Cat Waco, Komatsu Chattanooga, Komatsu Franklin, Takeuchi Moore). Liebherr Newport News kept IN (expansion adds side-frame production) and Cat Denison kept IN low (welder postings seen in search, not fetched). (8) Registry rows with stale or absent ECHO inspections and no current source were set OUT as 'status unconfirmed' (Joy Salyersville, Paladin Manchester, Paladin Customworks Davenport/Dubuque, JRB Chattanooga); Cat Tazewell OUT (production moved to Houston PA in 2013).
